# myth frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:mythFrame`](gmeow-mythFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/mythFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

The narrative reference frame under which in-myth claims hold true. Functional: one frame per [`Myth`](../classes/gmeow-Myth.md). In-myth claims are scoped [`accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) this frame.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Myth`](../classes/gmeow-Myth.md) -> [`gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeReferenceFrame.md); functional
